text:
maria: Quick update — Zenith private rollout scheduled for Tue 08:00 UTC. Need cross-team check: network routing, airgap artifact delivery, and final ownership for canary.
aj: On routing — net team flagged missing SNAT rule for the egress box, working up a CIDR list now.
sam_k: Can you drop the CIDRs here? I need to add to customer firewall doc.
maria: Will paste in a sec. also flag: customer still needs org-level cert whitelist for internal CA. ralph_pm flagged.
ralph_pm: Confirmed — customer security asked for the CNs and cert fingerprints. Sam, i can share an export by EOD.
tina-ng: On artifact delivery for airgap: ops needs signed tarball + sha256. Is that what you expect, connor.ops?
connor.ops: yes — signed tar + accompanying detached signature (.sig). ops will push to the airlock; we need GPG key exchange with their infra contact (zenith-sec).
netops-bot: Reminder: deploy ticket #ZEN-312 slated for Tue 08:00 UTC. Add owners to the ticket to avoid automatic rollback.
aj: pasted CIDRs: 10.12.0.0/16, 10.20.0.0/22, 172.31.200.0/24; plus NAT egress to 34.89.120.0/24 (monitoring) and 52.14.33.0/24 (metrics).
sam_k: thanks. i'll update the runbook and send to Zenith contact.
maria: Small prod note — if canary latency >500ms for >5% of requests we fallback to hosted model. Can ops add a smoke that checks tail latency in the first 10m?
connor.ops: yeah we can add a 1m tail-latency query against the canary route. i'll add it to the smoke and to the alert policy: Sev-2 if sustained.
tina-ng: for airgap signing — here's the snippet i used last week:
```bash
# create detached signature
gpg --output model.tar.gz.sig --detach-sign model.tar.gz
# verify
gpg --verify model.tar.gz.sig model.tar.gz
```
maria: perfect. two blockers left: 1) Zenith needs a VPN peer IP (we gave them our gateway but not the peer) and 2) they haven't accepted the service account role for artifact retrieval.
aj: VPN peer IP = 198.51.100.12 (static). I'll add to ticket.
ralph_pm: i'll chase Zenith PM for the service account acceptance now. if they don't accept by EOD tomorrow we postpone canary.
sam_k: quick CR ping — i left comments on the ingress-rule PR (port 10250 vs 10255 mixup). need an ack from netops before i merge.
netops-bot: netops-oncall @aj assigned to ticket ZEN-312 at 2026-03-18T16:12:00Z.
aj: acked the PR comments, will push fix in next 30m. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks everyone. action items summary: (1) aj update CIDR+VPN peer in ticket, (2) connor add tail-latency smoke + alert, (3) ralph chase service-account acceptance, (4) sam merge ingress fix after netops ack, (5) tina produce signed artifact and share GPG pubkey. if all green we'll start canary Tue 08:00 UTC.
ralph_pm: noted. ping me if Zenith stalls and i'll escalate.
maria: closing loop — i'll post final preflight checklist tomorrow morning in this thread. :white_check_mark:
